Подключи iPhone к Wi-Fi малины. В этой в: Join the Pi Wi-Fi, click Pair an iPhone, and wait for Select GeoBox on your iPhone. Open pairing within Developer Mode on the phone and select GeoBox. The separate Developer → Paired Computers screen was empty on the tested version.
После выбора GeoBox здесь появится шести: A six-digit PIN appears here after you select GeoBox. Enter it on the iPhone. It is not the Wi-Fi password or screen passcode. Only the initiating panel session can see the PIN. Pairing expires after five minutes; restart it to get a new code.

Сначала измерим IPv4 и IPv6 по HTTPS, за: Checks IPv4 and IPv6 over HTTPS, then WebRTC addresses. On request, your browser contacts api.ipify.org, api6.ipify.org and Google STUN (stun.l.google.com:19302). These services see the request source. No camera, microphone or automatic external requests.
Профиль определяется по адресу подключен: The profile is identified from your panel connection address. A device VPN, Private Relay or cellular service may route external requests differently.
Совпадение IP — только совпадение с прош: IP matching compares with the last check. Rotating proxies may change IP; a mismatch alone does not prove a leak. Country and city describe the IP, not GPS.
По нажатию браузер обратится к api.ipify: On request, your browser contacts api.ipify.org and api6.ipify.org. These services see the request source. Results stay on this page.
По нажатию браузер запросит STUN-сервер: On request, your browser contacts Google STUN at stun.l.google.com:19302, exposing the request source to that server. No camera or microphone is used. One STUN check does not represent every application.
В конфигурации GeoBox DNS клиентов напра: GeoBox configures client DNS through the proxy. This is not a test result. Identifying the actual resolver requires a separate DNS leak test with unique queries. Browsers and apps may use their own DNS.
Только по нажатию и с разрешения браузер: Requires your request and browser permission. This page does not store coordinates on the Pi or send them to an external service; your system location service may contact its provider. A proxy does not change GPS, time zone or browser permissions.
Отдельная проверка настроек и состояния: Checks router settings and status at the time of the test. This does not verify the browser route, every application's DNS or absence of leaks. The button reloads the page; finish browser tests first.
